attractions.name: The Lost Feather
attractions.synopsis: Watch magnificent birds of prey soar just above the crowd in a breathtaking free-flight display, as a heartfelt tale of a lost feather unfolds beneath open skies.
attractions.sensoryNotes: Sudden bird movements and occasional loud calls.

attractions.name: The Trusty Steed
attractions.synopsis: Follow the journey of a young girl and her trusty steed in a spectacular medieval tale filled with daring horsemanship, stunts and unforgettable characters.
attractions.sensoryNotes: Live horses, galloping, theatrical fire effects.

attractions.name: Legend of the Wear
attractions.synopsis: The legendary tale of the Lambton Worm is brought to life on a vast lake with water effects, pyrotechnics and larger-than-life creatures.
attractions.sensoryNotes: Pyrotechnics, loud bangs, water spray near the front rows.

attractions.name: Land of the Vikings
attractions.tagline: Warriors clash amid fire and action
attractions.synopsis: Witness Viking warriors clash amid fire, steel and thundering action in an immersive Norse settlement alive with longships and legend.
attractions.sensoryNotes: Combat sequences, fire effects, loud crowd and drums.

attractions.name: Victorian Imaginariums
attractions.tagline: An outdoor maze packed with surprises
attractions.synopsis: Lose yourself in the mysteries of the Victorian Imaginariums, an outdoor maze of curiosities, illusions and delightful surprises around every corner.

attractions.name: Kynren – An Epic Tale of England
attractions.synopsis: On selected evenings, a cast and crew of 1,000 volunteers take audiences on an epic journey through 2,000 years of English history across a vast outdoor stage.
attractions.sensoryNotes: Large-scale pyrotechnics, horses, fireworks and loud music.

content.title: Opening Times
content.body: Kynren – The Storied Lands is open Tuesday to Sunday, 18 July – 12 September 2026. Gates open at 10:00. Last entry 15:00.

content.title: Getting Here
content.body: Flatts Farm, Bishop Auckland, County Durham. Free on-site parking. Sat nav: DL14 7SF.

content.title: Accessibility
content.body: Step-free routes across the park, accessible viewing areas, accessible toilets and a sensory guide. Assistance dogs welcome. Free carer tickets available.

content.title: Safety & Effects
content.body: Some shows feature pyrotechnics, fire, loud noises and live animals. Ear defenders are available to borrow from Guest Services.

content.title: Do I need to book?
content.body: Yes — advance booking is strongly recommended as capacity is limited. Advance Saver tickets start from £30 adult / £20 child.

announcements.title: Welcome to The Storied Lands
announcements.body: Plan your day, add shows to your itinerary and we’ll remind you before each one begins. Enjoy the magic!
